deliverables: fund builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL
operate a builder-led DAO proposal review, feedback, voting, and funding process
require funded projects to report core KPIs
continue development of KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data
disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated by an independent administrator
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO / independent dRep DAO council administrator prior to milestone-based disbursement
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for the Cardano Builder DAO, described as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate capital to builders advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The proposal states that funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO has built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 1 using public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moving toward live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO says it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Round 1 is described as involving 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, an 83% governance participation rate, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 is described as adding 18 new members, funding 14 companies, and achieving an 88% member participation rate after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal states that the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal says official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to on-chain activity, users, and TVL.

An independent council composed of dRep DAO members is proposed to receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, oversee milestone-aligned disbursement, keep held ADA in separate auditable accounts, avoid stake pool delegation, and delegate voting power to predefined abstain.

The proposal states that unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds would be returned to the Cardano Treasury and cites an adastat transaction for a prior return of 354,790 ADA after the first two governance rounds.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue a milestone-administered, KPI-oriented builder funding mechanism, but the anchor itself leaves full budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode detail to missing or external material.
